BEST PLACE TO SHOP for comfortable MEDICATED SOLE SHOES: I never went to this shop, nor I was recommended by someone to visit this brand. About 2 years back, my wife bought 2 pairs of medicated sole shoes from Bata which were very comfortable and she was very happy with these. Since she is a working woman, she has to keep walking throughout the day and without medicated sole shoes her feet start aching. When these shoes got worn out, we searched for medicated sole shoes throughout nearly all brands in Lahore but we were not able to get any. We visited multiple stores of Bata to get the old model shoes but could not find these anywhere. Fully disappointed, I thought of searching internet for medicated sole shoes. To my surprise I discovered BORJAN on internet search for medicated sole shoes.
Next day we visited Borjan MM Alam store. To my pleasant surprise, the brand has the largest variety of Medicated Sole Shoes for both men and women. We bought 3 pairs for my wife and 2 pairs for myself. Life is very comfortable since then. We don’t fear long walks and long hours of work now. Later I went with my father to Borjan and he is very happy to shop with Borjan as now his feet feel full comfort all day. I fully endorse this brand for shoe sopping anytime.
